topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The walls of this house, they whisper secrets of the past. I should have been wary of the creaks that didn't sound like the settling of old wooden floors. It was behind the bookshelf, a panel that seemed a little too perfect, too untouched by the years. The room beyond, cloaked in shadows, held a chill that didn’t wane even when I stepped back into the hallway. The air grew thick, heavy with the weight of things left unsaid, unexplored. I closed the panel tightly, a barrier between me and whatever lies dormant in there, unsure if I should ever open it again.
